mainEntity.name: Copyfy or DiffShop: which one is the best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, product pages and going live. DiffShop is better if you mainly want to crunch a massive volume of multi-platform data. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for comprehensive data intelligence, DiffShop stays solid.

On the sticker price, yes (25$/month against 49€/month). On the real cost of your stack, no: DiffShop only covers e-commerce data analysis, so you have to add other subscriptions to launch a store, while Copyfy does the whole job for 49€/month with a 5-day trial and no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the best product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the angle. DiffShop tracks over a billion references across multiple platforms, ideal for volume. Copyfy, for its part, targets winning products directly with AI and analyzes competitor stores to move fast toward a product to launch. To take action quickly, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, product pages and Shopify integration. DiffShop keeps the edge on pure multi-platform data depth: if large-scale intelligence is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial. DiffShop offers a freemium version but a limited one. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
